fields.label: Screen Type
fields.description: Use the actual Desk screen type.

fields.label: Screen Name
fields.description: Page or Workspace name, or the DocType of a Form or List.

fields.label: Field Name
fields.description: Optional internal field name. Never a field value.

fields.label: Known Error Code
fields.description: An approved stable error code, never an exception body or business data.

fields.label: Guide Path
fields.description: Logical Compendium path, for example guide/search. No file paths or external URLs.

fields.label: Form Tour
fields.description: An existing native Frappe tour for the same screen.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Higher numbers first, after exact error and field matches.
